items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: Me, Mutt and Laurie stand by the pool room. And we come along with Harry Sutton.

ctx.x: Louie told Harry Sutton one day, we stand by the corner. After all that went around there and played. Me, Mutt and Laurie stand by the pool room. And we come along with Harry Sutton. Oh boy. The old boy said, a hammer wasn't big enough to cut my head. He had to get an act to chop my head off. So I saw that. He walked up. He said, I know. He had told Lee, well Lee, Lee Larkin, well he used to go around his barber shop and squint and he went around and went around. He told Lee, he said, well Lee says, all the band…
When did you go to Chicago, how long did you stay out of Chicago? How long did you stay out here then?
